# SmartScanner

> SmartScanner is an AI-powered web application vulnerability scanner for testing websites, APIs, and modern JavaScript applications on Windows.

## Product

SmartScanner automates dynamic application security testing (DAST) through a point-and-click interface. It adapts scanning methods to each target and reports vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, open redirects, path traversal, sensitive data leakage, cryptographic weaknesses, insecure dependencies, and configuration flaws.

The product supports authenticated pages, JavaScript-heavy applications, REST APIs, single-page applications built with React or Vue, server-side technologies including PHP, .NET, and Node.js, common web servers, CMS platforms, and relational databases.

## Plans and pricing

- Free: $0/month; unlimited targets and scans; limited vulnerability details.
- Pro: $25/month billed monthly, or $20/month billed annually at $240 upfront; full vulnerability details and ongoing updates; requires an internet connection.
- Perpetual: $599 per seat one time; full vulnerability details; works offline and includes one year of upgrades. Upgrade renewal is $219/year, or $149 when renewed before expiry.

See the machine-readable pricing details at [/pricing.md](/pricing.md) and the human pricing page at [/pricing](/pricing).
